title: Time off
description: Vacation and sick hours recorded here go on your timesheet. Balances aren’t tracked here; they live in the payroll system.

request.title: Record time off
request.preview: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} × {hours} h = {total} h of {kind}
request.previewSkipped: {count, plural, one {# weekend day} other {# weekend days}} skipped
request.invalidDates: Choose a first and a last day.
request.invalidOrder: The last day is before the first.
request.invalidHours: Hours per day must be more than 0 and at most 24.
request.tooLong: One request covers at most {max} days. Split it into shorter runs.
request.noDays: That range has only weekend days. Include Saturdays and Sundays to record them.
request.failed: Couldn’t record the time off. Nothing was saved.
request.donePending: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ({total} h) requested. It waits for your manager or an admin to approve.
request.doneRecorded: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ({total} h) recorded. No approval is needed.

list.emptyUpcoming: No time off coming up. Record vacation or sick time above.
list.emptySoFar: No time off taken yet this year.
list.removeDescription: {hours} h of {kind} on {day} will be removed from your timesheet.
list.locked: In a submitted timesheet, so it can’t be removed
